# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 29 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Sinaiticus (ch 1-31) / P.Mich. 130 (ch 32+), Shepherd of Hermas 29 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_029_page_001.jpg

---

## Mandate 3 — Truth

**1** Again he spoke to me: "Love truth, and let nothing but truth proceed from your mouth, that the spirit which God caused to dwell in this flesh may be found true by all men, and the Lord who dwells in you will thus be glorified — for the Lord is true in every word, and there is no falsehood in him. **2** Those therefore who lie disown the Lord and defraud him, not giving back to him the deposit which he gave them. For they received from him a spirit free of deceit. If they give it back lying, they have dishonored and defiled the deposit of the Lord who is true. **3** But those who always practice truth will be pleasing to God and will live to God." **4** "And what shall become of those who falsify and lie?" "They shall have no life with God — unless they repent and turn from their lying and practice truth again. For those who repent of their lying are sanctified. Blessed are all the righteous who keep the commandments of the Lord."

---

*EMET note: Mandate 3 is brief but theologically dense. The spirit given to humans is described as a "deposit" (parathēkē) — a banking term for entrusted goods. Lying defiles this divine deposit. The indwelling Spirit and truth are inextricably linked.*
